summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q1 Fiscal 2027 financial results for the three months ended June 30, 2026. The company reported revenue of $138.7 million, net income of $59.4 million, adjusted earnings of $53.9 million, and cash flow from operations of $61.7 million. The filing highlights production of 1.5 million ounces of silver, a strong treasury position of $387.1 million, and capital expenditures on development projects. The report notes a recent $60.0 million payment to close the acquisition of Chaarat ZAAV, but this is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special-situation event.
